name: scenario_Services_audio_drives_the_effects
description: Audio arrives wired on every device and synthesized by default, so the effects react before a microphone is attached to anything. Proves the default is what ships, that a source change takes, and that the choice survives a restart.

steps.name: simulate-is-the-default
steps.description: A device demonstrates sound with nothing attached, which is why this mode is first.

steps.name: pick-the-microphone
steps.description: A board with a real microphone selects local audio, the way its catalog entry does.

steps.name: restart
steps.description: Restart, because a source that reverts leaves a mic board silently synthesizing.

steps.name: back-to-simulate
steps.description: Back to the default, so the scenario leaves the device as it found it.

reset.name: reset-audio-mode
reset.description: Put the source back to simulate, so the default assertion below reads a known state rather than whatever ran before.
